experiment.objective: Can on-policy guarded VOI improve actual CartPoleWind survival and stability versus the strongest competent FIT-selected A-opt, goal-directed greedy, physical balance and fully trained SSM dynamics control?

learning.learner_candidate_and_simple_controls: P108 strict confirmed-action RLS on 16D P80 factual action/effect, 512 float64 W/P state, same source observations

SSM_control.validation: source-free training-budget/manifest qualification before real training; only actual owner-trained checkpoint qualifies real F6
SSM_control.collect_train_action_policy: physical_balance for SSM arm on FIT blocks 0-1; those 32 sessions are already counted in SSM arm; choose exactly one observed action each step, never extra outcomes
SSM_control.FIT_selection_policy: trained ssm256_model_based on FIT block2 new on-policy sessions, no influence of CAL
SSM_control.SSM_action_rule: Choose legal action minimizing one-step predicted normalized physical tracking penalty, using learned model, not true alternate action effect
SSM_control.checkpoints: three seed training receipts use only SSM-arm FIT train data; checkpoint chosen FIT block2, never CAL, no pickle, source SHA and optimizer evidence
SSM_control.policy_capability: SSM state/capacity differs from RLS and is reported, not falsely described as matched model capacity
SSM_control.cost: record per arm training, all model inference, source constructor/reset/do/receipts/fsync, wall and peak RSS; no synthetic F3 replay

learning.FIT_selection: All arms evaluated on the 16 source worlds in FIT block2; strongest conventional selected by highest factual survival, then lowest mean physical stability cost, then frozen conventional order. Training/scoring on CAL forbidden.
learning.future_CAL: Only if distinct owner authorization is granted and actual FIT incumbent trained/qualified, source receipts complete and no unresolved session; select exactly one strongest conventional from FIT and keep all five policies in CAL for transparent comparisons.

acceptance.primary: Survival steps/world, intention-to-treat with every episode included and early terminations not excluded
acceptance.secondary: Normalized physical stability cost and factual cumulative reward
acceptance.thresholds: On >=2/3 prospectively frozen CAL blocks, guarded VOI mean survival >=1.10 x strongest FIT-selected conventional AND normalized physical cost <=0.95 x same; 5000-bootstrap pooled seeded paired-world lower 95pct confidence bound for survival gain >0; no posthoc tuning.
acceptance.controls: Wrong-action-credit offline negative, full cold checkpoint readback, valid option restriction, no speculative unchosen effects, cost and training receipts, no CAL-based model/seed selection
acceptance.competence: FIT selected strongest conventional mean survival >=24/96 and authentic fully trained SSM manifest qualified; otherwise stop before CAL
acceptance.failure: Preserve negative/null, no more new CAL/OOD, do not retune
acceptance.paired_noise_caveat: Identical world seed across policy-specific env sessions does not imply identical exogenous noise or same-state counterfactual outcome; report differences and confidence intervals with caveat

owner_integrity.preeffect: Exact selected candidate freeze and owner-run SHA, source license/blobs/environment/Python, owner runner state, native WSL POSIX dir-fsync readback, exclusive attempt receipts + model-state hash must be verified; GitHub-hosted CI must never import upstream environment
owner_integrity.session_unique: (plan_sha, split,block,index,policy), O_EXCL claim before any first-use, no replay of uncertain-effect source steps or sessions
owner_integrity.do_cap: Stop at frozen split maximum, even if episodes are short. Never top up short episodes or discard terminal sessions.
